Package ca.refundr.highspring.api.resource.version1.admin

Class AdminJavadocResource

java.lang.Object
ca.refundr.highspring.api.resource.AbstractResource
ca.refundr.highspring.api.resource.AbstractChildResource<AdminResource>
ca.refundr.highspring.api.resource.version1.admin.AdminJavadocResource
public final class AdminJavadocResource extends AbstractChildResource<AdminResource>
Serves published JavaDoc (and the HTTP status guide) to admins only.

Nested paths under /v1/admin/javadoc/ map to files in JAVADOC_REPORT_DIR (default published-javadoc/apidocs/). Generate with: mvn javadoc:aggregate or mvn verify.

Start at index.html — overview links to HttpStatusGuide for REST error codes.
